english_head: It is common then to property and inseparable accident not to subsist without those things in which they are beheld, for as man does not subsist without risible,[^45] so neither can Ethiopian subsist without blackness, and as property is present to every, and always, so also is inseparable accident. Nevertheless, they differ, in that property is present to one species alone, as the being risible to man, but inseparable accident, as black, is present not only to an Ethiopian, but also to a crow,
